definitions.explanation: A person who installs, maintains, and repairs electrical systems and equipment.

examples.japanese: {電気技師|でんきぎし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配線|はいせん}→配線：07862_haisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had an electrician inspect the wiring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電気技師|でんきぎし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{電気技師|でんきぎし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{調|しら}べている→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: An electrician is investigating the cause of the power outage.

notes:
RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{電気工事士|でんきこうじし}→電気工事士：30200_denkikoujishi⟧ (licensed electrician - official term for the Japanese qualification)
- {電気屋|でんきや}さん (electrician - colloquial)

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, ⟦{電気工事士|でんきこうじし}→電気工事士：30200_denkikoujishi⟧ is the official qualification for electrical work. There are two levels: {第一種|だいいっしゅ} (Class 1) and {第二種|だいにしゅ} (Class 2).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気技師|でんきぎし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call an electrician)
- {電気技師|でんきぎし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask an electrician for repairs)
